Electrochemical kinetics 
To comprehend the charge storage mechanism thoroughly, the electrochemical kinetics of the MF electrode was conducted. A power-law equation governs the current (i) and scan rate (v) of the CV curves as follows [1, 2]:
                     i=avb                           (1)                                       
where a and b are the adjusting parameters. In the case of b= 0.5, the charge storage mechanism is viewed as a semi-infinite diffusion-controlled process. And the surface-control model is recommended for b=1. Further, Dunn equation is used to study the contribution rate of pseudo and electric double layer capacitor (EDLC) capacitance[3, 4]:
                                              iV=k1v+k2v1/2                 (2)
where i(V) represents the current response at a constant voltage V, k1v corresponds to the capacitive control process and k2v1/2 corresponds to the diffusion control process; k1 and k2 are adjustable parameters obtained from the above equation at the specified voltage.
